assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a finished landscape game chapter cover for Sporelight, Moss Valley. Wide 3:2 composition, full bleed, no frame. A beautiful miniature isometric moss garden valley: rounded weathered ivory stone terraces and stairways, winding stepping stones, soft sage moss, delicate white and peach wildflowers, slender waterfalls between floating garden cliffs, distant hazy cypress silhouettes. Main cluster centered and readable at tiny thumbnail size. Warm golden morning light, dreamy cream mist, restrained sage green and muted honey palette. Hand-painted storybook gouache / watercolor with refined fine edges and soft atmospheric depth, tactile miniature diorama, gentle cozy puzzle-game mood. NO text, lettering, UI, icons, locks, numbers, people, borders or watermarks. Avoid busy tiny details, sharp black outlines, photorealism. This is environment cover art, not a playable map.
